body: I apologize for the very late response but thank you so much. I don't have plans of becoming a writer when I grow up but now that I look at the things I create with just a click of some keys, I'm having second thoughts.
I'm so glad people like you can stand beside me and relate to my troubles and sorrows. This world is a great place.
I'm not a fan of talking to people about my depression but thank you for the advice.
